description: This file defines the AppState class, which manages the application state including onboarding status, selected tab, user profile, and data caching. It utilizes SharedPreferences for local storage and communicates with external services like ApiService and NotificationService.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Represents the root application state, handling user onboarding, tab selection, profile details, and interactions with persistent storage and services.

methods.name: AppState
methods.description: Constructor initializing AppState with dependencies and loading onboarding status.

methods.name: setSelectedTab
methods.description: Updates the current selected tab index and notifies listeners.

methods.name: completeOnboarding
methods.description: Marks onboarding as complete, updates profile name, and saves data to local storage.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Loads the user's profile name from local storage.
